prompt: Yellow calls the big parade downtown
title: Big Parade Downtown
irony: Yellow calls everyone downtown so fast they race apart, so she must stop calling from her porch and march with them to bring the big parade together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sunny street glows downtown, banners flap, drums thump as neighbors gather for the big parade.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green clutches his route map, reciting dino march facts while Navy waves flags and Jade bounces beside Yellow's porch.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Yellow shouts the start call from her porch, and Black dares everyone to race downtown for the front spot.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street sings the parade chant and starts marching downtown together behind Yellow's call.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The kids sprint downtown, the line snaps apart, Green freezes at the crossing without his book page.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Black trips over flags, Jade skids, drums drown Yellow's call, and the parade bunches in a giggling heap.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The whole street sings the parade chant again, still scattered, trying to march downtown together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Yellow sits alone on her porch, holding her mic, hearing only echoes where the marchers stand.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Yellow drops her mic stand, steps down, and Green makes room for her in the line.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Yellow marches inside the line, calling slower, and the scattered kids fall into step downtown.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The chant rings out, sunny street glows downtown again, Yellow marches inside, everyone parades as one.
